plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full lumen-research system, prioritizing the primary chatbot/agent interface flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will start by testing the core chat interface, including typing in the textarea, using the 'Ask' button, and clicking suggested follow-up prompts. Next, it will validate header controls like 'Share thread', 'Export as PDF', and the 'Mode' selector. The run will then examine the left rail history links and the right rail sources panel, paying special attention to mobile responsiveness given the small tap target warnings flagged during prescan.
assumptions: As a static local demo, interactive features like exporting PDFs, sharing threads, or creating new threads may only display UI feedback (like alerts or state toggles) rather than performing full backend operations.
risk_hotspots: Left rail history links (flagged for small tap targets, high risk on mobile)
Mode selector in the header (flagged for missing label)
Integration between inline citations in the chat and the right rail sources panel

phases.title: Chat Input and Suggestions
phases.objective: Validate the core interaction of sending a message and using suggested follow-ups.
key_checks: Type text into the main textarea and click 'Ask'
Click one of the suggested follow-up buttons at the bottom of the chat
exit_criteria: Chat input controls and suggested action buttons have been interacted with and their visual/functional responses observed.

phases.title: Header and Mode Controls
phases.objective: Test the utility actions available at the top of the conversation view.
key_checks: Change the selection in the 'Mode' dropdown
Change the selection in the response length/type dropdown next to 'Ask'
exit_criteria: All header action buttons and dropdowns have been toggled or clicked.

phases.title: Thread History (Left Rail)
phases.objective: Check navigation between past threads and creation of new ones, assessing accessibility.
key_checks: Click multiple history links (e.g., 'EV battery recycling policy...', 'Trace prevalence...')
Verify tap target sizes visually on mobile viewport
exit_criteria: New thread initiation and history navigation have been tested.

phases.title: Sources and Citations (Right Rail)
phases.objective: Evaluate the research sources panel and its sorting/filtering capabilities.
key_checks: Change the 'Sort' dropdown in the Sources panel
Click the 'All' filter or similar tabs if present
Attempt to click an inline citation in the chat text to see if it interacts with the right rail
exit_criteria: Source panel controls have been manipulated.

coverage_targets.features: Test chat input, suggestions, header utilities, history navigation, and source panel sorting.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat phase 3 checks (Left Rail) on mobile to assess the severity of small tap target warnings.

notes: Pay attention to how the layout adapts when switching between desktop and mobile, as the three-column design may collapse or require off-canvas navigation.
